whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Rock Fitness,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.8★ reviews with 274 happy members in Danapur, Patna, but your current website points to Yuva Fit Federation rather than a dedicated local fitness landing page.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom mobile-first website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, Sunday crossfit batch timings, aur trainer expertise highlight ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rockfit

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Rock Fitness, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile speed, and highlighting your 4.8-star rating in Danapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
